name: chrome-alert-width
brief: Close the three alert-width backlog rows left by 20261110-1618-chrome-alert-squeeze. The fork-UI hand-run driver gains S8-S10 and O24-O32: the reorder alert's effect on the Pod tab titles, the open-error and pods-error alerts with the Pod tabs overflowing, and a width-policy check for each alert. A base run happens before any renderer change. T2 then applies the width policy the user chooses at Gate 2 to the open-error and pods-error rows, and bounds PodBarPanel's reorder alert (wrapper, two-line clamp, title) only if the base run shows it squeezing the tabs. A fix run on the same driver bytes scores the result, and the findings file and a README bullet record it. Last, T4 writes docs/human-checks/chrome-alert-width.md, numbered steps the user follows before Gate 3, covering this session's visible changes and five pending human checks (fork mark, fork-error tooltip and clamp, open/pods-error clamp and tooltip, and whether the alert width tells the user enough). Four tasks run in a serial chain, because the driver, the build and vitest share one worktree.
